import numpy as np

# Generate a set of 10 orthogonal vectors
vectors = []
for i in range(10):
    v = np.random.rand(6)
    v = v / np.linalg.norm(v)
    vectors.append(v)

# Create the matrix
matrix = np.array(vectors).T

# Ensure all columns are non-zero
while np.any(np.all(matrix == 0, axis=0)):

print(matrix)
